title: Motion in Two and Three Dimensions

questions.q: Two projectiles are launched with the same speed at 30° and 60° above the horizontal. The ratio of their horizontal ranges $R_{30}:R_{60}$ (no air resistance) is
A projectile is launched at 60° above the horizontal. At the top of its trajectory, its kinetic energy is what fraction of its initial kinetic energy?
questions.e: At the top only $v_0\cos60°=v_0/2$ remains, so the energy is a fraction $\cos^2 60°=1/4$.

questions.q: An object moves uniformly in a circle. If the radius is doubled while the period stays the same, the centripetal acceleration
A boat moves at 5 m/s relative to the water, and the current flows at 3 m/s. How long does it take to cross a 200 m wide river along a path perpendicular to the bank?
questions.e: The boat must compensate for the current: the perpendicular component is $\sqrt{5^2-3^2}=4$ m/s, so $200/4=50$ s.
